# Boundary metrics reference

Boundary exposes metrics at the `/metrics` path of a listener with the `ops` purpose, in OpenMetrics format for collection by Prometheus. This reference lists the metrics that controllers and workers export and the labels that apply to them.

To enable metrics and collect them with Prometheus, refer to [Configure metrics collection](/boundary/docs/monitor/configure-metrics).

## Controller metrics

The following table lists the metrics that controllers export.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `boundary_controller_api_http_request_duration_seconds` | Histogram of latencies for HTTP requests. |
| `boundary_controller_api_http_request_size_bytes` | Histogram of request sizes for HTTP requests. |
| `boundary_controller_api_http_response_size_bytes` | Histogram of response sizes for HTTP requests. |
| `boundary_controller_api_ratelimiter_quota_storage_capacity` | A gauge of storage capacity for API rate limiting quotas. |
| `boundary_controller_api_ratelimiter_quota_storage_usage` | A gauge of storage usage for API rate limiting quotas. |
| `boundary_controller_cluster_grpc_request_duration_seconds` | Histogram of latencies for requests made to the gRPC service running on the cluster listener. |
| `boundary_controller_cluster_accepted_connections_total` | Count of total accepted network connections to this controller. |
| `boundary_controller_cluster_closed_connections_total` | Count of total closed network connections to this controller. |

## Worker metrics

The following table lists the metrics that workers export.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `boundary_worker_proxy_http_write_header_duration_seconds` | Histogram of time elapsed after the TLS connection is established to when the first HTTP header is written back from the server. |
| `boundary_worker_proxy_websocket_active_connections` | A gauge of the current count of open proxy connections on the worker. |
| `boundary_worker_proxy_websocket_received_bytes_total` | Count of bytes received over all proxy connections handled by the worker. |
| `boundary_worker_proxy_websocket_sent_bytes_total` | Count of bytes sent over all proxy connections handled by the worker. |
| `boundary_worker_cluster_grpc_request_duration_seconds` | Histogram of latencies for gRPC requests between a worker server and a worker client. |
| `boundary_worker_cluster_accepted_connections_total` | Count of total accepted network connections to this worker. |
| `boundary_worker_cluster_closed_connections_total` | Count of total closed network connections to this worker. |

## Build information metrics

The following table lists the miscellaneous build information metrics that Boundary provides.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `boundary_build_info` | A gauge set to 1 with labels that detail the current Go version, git revision, and Boundary version. |

## Metric labels

Metrics use labels to organize and narrow their scope so you can filter measurements for more flexible analysis.

### HTTP request labels

| Label | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `code` | The HTTP status code of the request, such as `200` or `400`. |
| `path` | The path, excluding query parameters, of the request. Resource IDs are replaced with `{id}`. For example, `/v1/groups/{id}`. Any unrecognized path receives the value `unknown`. |
| `method` | The HTTP method of the request, such as `GET`, `POST`, or `DELETE`. |

### gRPC request labels

| Label | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `grpc_method` | The name of the method on the gRPC service, such as `GetGroup`. |
| `grpc_service` | The proto service name including the package, such as `controller.api.services.v1.GroupService`. |
| `grpc_code` | The gRPC [status code](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/blob/master/codes/codes.go) in human-readable format, such as `OK`, `IllegalArgument`, or `Unknown`. |
